source_warnings: The sentence names no layer and no per-perturbation summary statistic. On the same 280 K562 CRISPRi perturbations the article prints attention 0.704 against correlation 0.703 at the pre-specified layer L13 (page 7, Wilcoxon p = 0.73; page 10, 'statistically indistinguishable') and 0.743 at L15, the best layer under nested cross-validation (page 7), 0.040 above correlation. Neither gives +0.060 [+0.040, +0.080], and the same paragraph sums up K562 CRISPRi as 'equal'. The RPE1 value in the same sentence, +0.090, does equal the printed L15 difference (0.748 - 0.658). What +0.060 measures cannot be resolved from the article; the cited Supplementary Note 14 is not pinned. Recorded as printed.
